🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF: Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1 — defensive names showing relative strength (JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +9.16%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +0.79%), CVS ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.51% | 1M: +8.01%)); Confirmation 2 — Financials and Industrials are both weak (Financials 1W: -0.52%, Industrials 1W: -1.07%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology/Communication in top performers), caution advised.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.72% | 1M: +8.09%), CVX ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.85% | 1M: +7.75%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +20.73%). Communication outperformance via NFLX ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%) and selective names in RECOVERY. Technology mixed but up 1W: PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.27% | 1M: +0.43%), INTU RECOVERY (1W: +20.81% | 1M: -13.14%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: CRH BELOW TREND (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -7.24%), overall Materials 1W: -3.16%. Consumer Discretionary weak: NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -3.28%), F BELOW TREND (1W: -10.56% | 1M: -7.51%). Consumer Staples soft: EL BELOW TREND (1W: -14.11% | 1M: -14.11%), sector 1W: -3.13%.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.19% | 1M: +17.02%), INTU RECOVERY (1W: +20.81% | 1M: -13.14%), PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.27% | 1M: +0.43%), NOW RECOVERY (1W: +10.44% | 1M: -3.26%), PANW RECOVERY (1W: +10.18% | 1M: -11.80%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology/Communication) — narrow leadership is a caution flag.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NKE BELOW TREND (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -3.28%), AMAT CORRECTION (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +9.13%), CRH BELOW TREND (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -7.24%), LOW BELOW TREND (1W: -7.50% | 1M: -3.50%), MNST BELOW TREND (1W: -7.66% | 1M: -2.19%). Weakness concentrated in Consumer and select Materials/Tech names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: NFLX ABOVE TREND (1W: +25.19%), INTU RECOVERY (1W: +20.81%), PLTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.27%), NOW RECOVERY (1W: +10.44%), PANW RECOVERY (1W: +10.18%). Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across large caps (AAPL CORRECTION, MSFT RECOVERY, NVDA BELOW TREND) — treat as tactical signals, watch for trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed/rotational: AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -3.08% | 1M: +1.74%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +3.84% | 1M: -5.91%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%). Sector showed a 1W uptick but 1M weakness; breadth mixed and leadership narrow.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft overall: JPM RECOVERY (1W: +1.00% | 1M: -1.84%), V RECOVERY (1W: +4.43% | 1M: -0.11%), MA RECOVERY (1W: +5.29% | 1M: -2.69%) — many names with short-term strength but 1M weakness; sector 1W: -0.52% and not confirming a cyclical rally.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive tone: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.19% | 1M: +9.16%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +0.79%), LLY BELOW TREND (1W: -3.30% | 1M: -2.67%). Sector breadth modestly positive; healthcare is a relative safe harbor within this RISK-OFF.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor defensives and high-quality income/energy exposure and reduce exposure to high-beta tech and discretionary names showing clear BELOW TREND action (AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -10.70% | 1M: -19.34%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -6.93%)). Style: Value over Growth given defensive leadership and weak Financials/Industrials; monitor narrow leadership and major divergence for confirmation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.57% | 1M: +0.79%) — continued defensive demand; VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +20.73%) — energy momentum. BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%) — downside persistence, AMZN RECOVERY (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -12.77%) — news-driven volatility, AMAT CORRECTION (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +9.13%) — watch for follow-through vs bullish commentary.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.58% | 1M: +13.05%) — breadth and momentum supportive. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary (1W: -3.05% | 1M: -2.84%) and Materials (1W: -3.16% | 1M: +4.33%) — monitor earnings/news and macro sensitivity.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -5.80%): watch prior support; AAPL CORRECTION (1W: -3.08% | 1M: +1.74%): test of recent swing lows would confirm weakness; JPM RECOVERY (1W: +1.00% | 1M: -1.84%): follow-through above recent highs would signal financials stabilization.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMAT (+55): Applied Materials bullish headlines vs price CORRECTION (1W: -7.04% | 1M: +9.13%) — bullish news but near-term selling = divergence, watch for supply-chain confirmation. CRH (+55): positive news but CRH BELOW TREND (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -7.24%) — fundamentals vs price conflict. SHOP (+70) flagged in news but lacks dual-timeframe in today's data; monitor if price follows sentiment.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
CVS (-55): negative regulatory headline vs price ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.51% | 1M: +8.01%) — distribution risk as sentiment diverges from price. AMZN (-50): negative headlines with AMZN RECOVERY (1W: +0.08% | 1M: -12.77%) — watch for follow-through. LRCX (-50): bearish news and LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -11.05% | 1M: -6.93%) — confirms downside risk.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with Value tilt. JNJ ABOVE TREND, UNH ABOVE TREND and Energy names (VLO ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength. Major divergence among large-cap Tech (AAPL CORRECTION, MSFT RECOVERY, NVDA BELOW TREND) and mixed news vs price (AMAT, CVS) is the key risk to monitor.
